lesson.title: Identity as an Act of Resilience
lesson.subject: sikhi

contentBlocks.text: Yesterday you learned what resilience means. Today: see how identity itself can be a form of resilience!

Remember the Five Ks from last week — a visible, shared identity every member of the Khalsa carries. Choosing to maintain a visible identity, openly and consistently, even when it might invite curiosity or difficulty from others, is itself a real act of resilience. It means staying true to who you are rather than hiding it. Explain in your own words why keeping a visible identity can take real courage.
You just connected identity to resilience! Tomorrow we'll learn how community adds another layer of strength.

objectives: Connect yesterday's resilience concept to maintaining a visible personal or community identity
Explain why keeping a visible identity can require real courage
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's resilience concept and last week's Five Ks.
2. Discuss how maintaining a visible identity connects to resilience.
3. Have the child explain the courage involved in their own words.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's community lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: use a simple relatable analogy — wearing a team jersey proudly even somewhere it's less common — to make the concept concrete
Ready for more: ask the child to think of another group (of any kind) whose visible identity also represents a form of quiet resilience

Kept deliberately general — this lesson connects identity to resilience as a concept, without describing specific historical persecution events, which are reserved for future, more carefully sourced lessons
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a reflection activity — check that the child gives a genuine explanation connecting visible identity to courage and staying true to oneself, even when it might draw attention or questions.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'Sikh identity' and 'resilience' descriptions together, connecting last week's Five Ks content to this week's resilience thread.
